running.backupsIntro: The backup service of your installation makes the backups; this page tells it how often, and shows what it reported. It picks up a change within a minute.

running.workerAbsent: The backup service last checked in {{when}}. Check that it still runs.
running.keyPresent: The backup service holds a backup key, fingerprint {{fingerprint}}.
running.keyMissing: The backup service has no backup key, so it cannot make backups. Run scripts/setup-secrets.sh.
running.requested: A backup was asked for {{when}} and waits for the backup service.
running.making: The backup service is making the backup asked for {{when}}.
running.intervalHours: Back up every so many hours
running.intervalHelp: Empty: as the installation was started, every {{hours}} hours.
running.intervalHelpNoWorker: Empty: as the installation was started.
running.keepHelp: Empty: as the installation was started, {{keep}}.
running.keepHelpNoWorker: Empty: as the installation was started.
running.empty: The backup service has not reported a backup yet.
running.restoreNone: No test restore was reported yet. Run scripts/restore-check.sh every week from a timer, as the backup guide says.
running.restoreOk: The test restore of {{name}} passed {{when}}, in {{seconds}} seconds.

running.configIntro: What this server reads when it starts, and where each value came from. Secrets show as (set). Change them in the environment or the configuration file, then restart.
running.configProblems: A restart would refuse to start, because of:
running.sessionsIntro: Log one person out on every device, without disabling their account, for example after a lost laptop.
running.endAllWarn: After an incident you can log everyone out, you included. Everyone must log in again.

instance.title: Look of this instance

care.unusedHelp: Files in storage that nothing refers to. Files younger than a day are left alone.
